verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a hosted web-scraping API, so letting developers plug in Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy (for example via a CDP or remote-browser endpoint) is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows only its own scrape, crawl, extract and browser-action endpoints plus its own SDKs, CLI and MCP server, with no mention of compatibility with any open-source automation library. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".
